column1: # The cases of tests/export_search_strategy.rs (line RG, item F1): one run of LOSAT PROGRAM ARGS from LOSAT/,
# with -num_threads 1, 4 and 8 added, in a clean environment plus env (NAME=VALUE, comma-separated; - = none).
# args are split at spaces (%20 is a space inside an argument); {ss} is a file in the run's own folder.
# pre: text written to {ss} before the run (- = no file). check: ncbi = the strategy file ({ss} after the run,
# or its absence), standard output, standard error and exit status rc equal NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 -num_threads 1
# (fixtures/strategy/<name>.ss, .out, .err; an absent .out or .err is empty; the run folder's path in NCBI's
# messages is written as {ENGINE}); parser = NCBI's argument reader refuses (rc 1, its usage and posts on standard error as
# NCBI wrote them, .err, nothing on standard output) and the file is as NCBI left it (.ss); refuse = LOSAT refuses (rc, standard error contains expect).
# near:NAME = LOSAT refuses at a query batch (rc, standard error contains expect), and the strategy file and the
# standard output are NCBI's of the ncbi row NAME, its run of a near input whose reader stops at that batch (line WQA
# D10 round 5, 2026-11-20: two queries with one id under -parse_deflines write no request of the refused batch).

# Cases rpsblast.3v.l2p63.q40, rpstblastn.3v.l2p63.nq.b2000 and blastp.db.dbsize.min (line RG D1a-4 fix round 2, item 7): removed. They were LOSAT's refusals of a request whose DbLength is exactly -2^63, which NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 writes as big-integer -0; LOSAT writes big-integer -9223372036854775808 (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS approved exception 17 (Int8 -2^63 written as digits), the Owner's Q1 = A of 2026-11-17). The check kinds compare NCBI's bytes or a refusal; the writer's unit tests pin the digits, and probe minus0 of fix round 2 compared the rest of each file with NCBI's.
